about_the_game:
About This Game

Step into the neon-lit streets of a cyberpunk metropolis where running your own futuristic store is the key to survival. In Cyberpunk Store Simulator, you’ll balance the chaos of daily business with the thrill of exploring a living city full of characters, stories, and opportunities.

Build, expand, and customize your shop as you serve a wide range of customers—from everyday citizens to eccentric buyers seeking cybernetic implants. Every decision matters: set prices, manage stock, hire staff, and protect your store against thieves while keeping up with the city’s demands. Outside the store, immerse yourself in a vibrant urban world with dynamic NPCs, traffic, and interactive environments.

Key Features

  • Hands on Store Management: Scan products at the counter, stock shelves, set prices, and keep customers happy.

  • Futuristic Customization: Upgrade your shop with neon signs, holograms, décor, and advanced security systems.

  • Cybernetic Goods: Sell implants, robotic arms, and other high-tech items that visibly change your customers in the city.

  • Living Cyberpunk City: Explore streets alive with NPC crowds, hovercars, and neon-lit nightlife powered by advanced AI.

  • Unique NPC Interactions: Encounter customers with distinct personalities, negotiate, handle complaints, and build your reputation.

  • Life Beyond the Store: Relax and decorate your own apartment, shaping both your lifestyle and your character’s identity.

  • Growth & Progression: Start small and transform your modest shop into a thriving cyber-store empire.

Are you ready to carve out your place in a neon dystopia? Add Cyberpunk Store Simulator to your wishlist and begin building your futuristic empire today!

name: Cyberpunk Store Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 3xxx
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (recent generation)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 or better 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Cyberpunk Store Simulator puts you in charge of a neon lit shop in a dystopian city. Manage stock, serve customers, sell cybernetic implants, and explore the streets. Build, customize, and grow your store into a futuristic empire.
